issues.competing_evidence: Littlefield+20 illustrates a non-unique solution with assumed Mwd=0.61 M_sun, Mdot=1e-12 M_sun/yr and i=67°; separate tomography inputs include q=0.15 and i=70°. These are model examples, not measurements.
issues.why_it_matters: Promoting assumptions would create false measured binary parameters.
issues.needed_action: Confirm these remain labeled model scenarios while measured Mwd/Mdot/q/i are blank.

issues.parameter: Harrison+18 cyclotron field, shock temperature and historical periods
issues.competing_evidence: Littlefield+20 secondarily quotes 12.3 MG, kT=14 keV and candidate periods 1.55/3.11 h (3.11 h slightly preferred there); original note inaccessible. K2 establishes 1.59277896±0.00000552 h.
issues.why_it_matters: Field/temperature remain secondary-only; period choice affects synchronization.
issues.needed_action: If accessible later, inspect Harrison+18 original; meanwhile keep quoted values secondary-only and neither old period adopted.

issues.competing_evidence: Littlefair+05 K-band spectrum has no secure donor absorption and is cyclotron dominated, undermining the early L-type/brown-dwarf color suggestion. Littlefield+20 favors M9±1 but M8/L0 fit nearly as well; no donor mass/Teff measured.
issues.why_it_matters: Substellar status implies a different donor/evolutionary interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Confirm display as “M9±1 template fit; M8/L0 alternatives” and leave substellar status unresolved pending mass/dynamical evidence.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 assumes fundamental ECM and donor-coronal/radio-plasma origin; Littlefield+20 directly measures separate 15±2 MG photospheric and 12±1 MG near-WD Zeeman fields.
issues.why_it_matters: Conflating the kG estimate with WD field would materially bias cross-population field comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Keep it separate and conditional; do not populate WD surface/pole fields from this radio estimate.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 gives 1.0±0.2e−10 (1–10 keV), 1.1±0.2e−10 (0.1–10 keV), unabsorbed/model converted. The 2RXS source has 29.72±6.24 counts, below Boller+16’s >=100-count fit criterion; exact Tau-specific conversion/error mapping is absent.
issues.why_it_matters: These are not direct flux measurements or contemporaneous radio/X-ray data.
issues.needed_action: Retain as model-converted estimates; decide whether to leave luminosity absent until a source-specific spectrum/conversion is recovered.
